name: Kazura Uta
source:
When you hear it, you die --
After a group of girls jumped from the school room, a gruesome investigation starts to unfold.
There's a website that's been going around SNS that plays a certain video...

...And if you hear the song on the video, well...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE273816.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
当你听到它时，你就死了——
一群女孩从教室跳下后，一场可怕的调查开始展开。
SNS上有一个网站正在播放某个视频……

…如果你在视频中听到这首歌，那么…

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE273816.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
